implementation: AGENTS.md defines feature-first focused validation; full suite is a phase integration gate, not an every-edit checklist
Media E2E selects pdf/audio/video independently while retaining shared real message/replay/restart checks
Web material analysis has summary/task/video presets; audio/video select appropriate defaults; drafts carry selected asset ID/revision and require explicit send
Task draft asks for source IDs and uncertain owners to be reviewed; it never assigns system accounts from transcript names
Reuses existing Native image observer; actual tool and HTTP provider payload hashes replace an invalid text-only SQLite image assertion

real_video.scope: Real isolated Compose/MySQL/Redis/Kafka, production parser, actual Pi/Hermes models and three HTTP/WS users. Synthetic 10-second video; not browsers. Pi/Hermes code baselines retained; only Hermes analyzes video.
checks: formal Native capabilities and HTTP whitelist deny chat/profile/tool/session bypasses
three independent users exchange real messages; normal chat does not invoke models
public-pi reads the real nonce and C++ file; all three clients see its attributed durable final
public-hermes reads the real nonce and C++ file; all three clients see its attributed durable final
original Native room broker receipt succeeds and both consumers commit without dead letters
selected media uploaded through real chunk APIs and published by production worker: video
Hermes video answer matches nonspoken image facts and audio; actual JPEGs observed in Native tool and provider requests
real native tool transcripts confirm file contents; Agents use separate sessions and share one IM timeline
Native process restart reuses the owned Profile without rewriting config, model auth or identity
tasks and handoff are persisted; duplicate client messages preserve completed execution records
Kafka redelivery after revoke, catalog disable and Connector/Bridge restart preserves one original result
full Compose restart and fresh login retain final messages, claimed task and membership revocation
selected media sources and attributed finals survive Kafka replay and full Compose restart; removed member is denied

earlier_failure.cause: Semantic video checks passed, but the harness expected JPEG data URLs in Native SQLite text history. The installed Native _durable_content intentionally projects images to [screenshot].
earlier_failure.fix: Observe exact image hashes in real tool and successful provider requests using the existing Native probe. The failed run remains failed; its unexecuted replay/recovery checks are not retroactively passed.

browser.scope: Actual Chromium with controlled HTTP/WS; includes selected fixed source, task draft and explicit-send behavior. Not real model acceptance of the new Chinese presets.

packaging.scope: Local image includes source/task links and material search. It predates the subsequent analysis-preset UI change; that UI was browser-tested from the working tree. No production deployment or push.

limits: PDF and 20-minute audio were not selected; prior ASR owner/action accuracy failure remains unresolved
Pi visual semantic failure from the independent image probe remains unresolved; this run uses Hermes for video
Saved task/restart checks here cover the existing code-review task, not a new audio-derived task
Three-client protocol E2E and controlled browser checks do not equal three-browser real media acceptance
Prompt asset IDs are target hints, not a new server-enforced asset binding protocol; each tool call remains authorized
Shared asset deletion, final-message structured citations, full media acceptance and worker deployment integration remain open
No full CTest or CANN/private-Agent regression rerun for these local harness/UI edits; unknown-run failure injection is separate
